parameters.query:
INSERT INTO cs_wiki_pages (epic_key, confluence_page_id, space_key, parent_page_id, page_title, fingerprint, status, last_action, updated_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,NOW())
ON CONFLICT (epic_key) DO UPDATE SET confluence_page_id = EXCLUDED.confluence_page_id, page_title = EXCLUDED.page_title, fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint, status = EXCLUDED.status, last_action = EXCLUDED.last_action, updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING epic_key, confluence_page_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Build Payload').first().json.epicKey, String($json.id || $('Build Payload').first().json.existingPageId), $('Build Payload').first().json.spaceKey, $('Build Payload').first().json.parentPageId, $('Build Payload').first().json.pageTitle, $('Build Payload').first().json.fingerprint, $('Build Payload').first().json.dbStatus, $('Build Payload').first().json.event.toLowerCase() ] }}

'\nMissing: ' + $('Build Payload').first().json.allFlags.join(', ') : '') }}
